description:
What Typestate is, what it costs, and how to connect to it. Call this
first if you have met this server for the first time and want to know
what it is for. Ask with no `about` and it answers all three parts at
once. Name a `service` and it also lists what a person must do before
Live works for that service (decision 0776).

about.description: Which part to answer: "what_it_is" for what the platform does, "connecting" for how an agent authenticates, "plans" for what it costs. Omit it to get all three.

service.description: A service slug. With it, the answer lists what a person must do before Live works for that service, one line each, with the page; hand them the list before the change.

name: get_started

answer.description: The answer, in English, ready to show a person.

live_steps.description: What a person must do before Live works for the service named, one line each. Empty when Live needs nothing, or no service was named.

mcp_endpoint.description: The address this server answers on.

notice.description: Background work that did not end well since your last call. list_runs names each run.

sign_up_url.description: Where a person opens an account.

website.description: Where a person reads more about the platform.

title: Get started with Typestate
